description: Defines classes for tracking instances, copies, moves, swaps, and comparisons of a test type, used for testing container behaviors in the Abseil library.

classes.name: BaseCountedInstance
classes.description: A class that counts its own instances, copies, moves, swaps, and comparisons for testing purposes.

classes.name: InstanceTracker
classes.description: A helper class to track the number of instances, copies, moves, swaps, and comparisons of BaseCountedInstance objects during tests.

classes.name: CopyableOnlyInstance
classes.description: A subclass of BaseCountedInstance that supports copying only, not moving.

classes.name: CopyableMovableInstance
classes.description: A subclass of BaseCountedInstance that supports both copying and moving.

classes.name: MovableOnlyInstance
classes.description: A subclass of BaseCountedInstance that supports moving only, not copying.

methods.name: SwapImpl
methods.description: Static method to swap two BaseCountedInstance objects, counting the swap.

methods.name: supports_move
methods.description: Static method indicating if the class supports move semantics.
